agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies on crossing orbits undergo a deep close encounter near step 21-22 (distance 1.197 at step 20 -> 0.762 at step 21 -> 0.465 at step 22, comparable to softening 0.3). Potential deepens from -747 to -1666 and kinetic rises to ~2081 with speeds ~7.75 and ~13.86. With outer dt~0.0333 (max allowed) the adaptive substepping (24-30 substeps) is insufficient to resolve pericenter of the softened Kepler problem, so leapfrog loses ~140 energy (drift, not oscillation) while momentum stays conserved, tripping energy_conserved. Reducing only dt to 0.005 eliminates the violation.
